sentences.text: By this judgment, I shall dispose off suit filed by plaintiff against defendant for effecting recovery of Rs.7.5 lacs/-.

2 Brief facts as set out in plaint are that the defendant is the husband of the plaintiff and there is matrimonial disputes pending against each other and in this regard, the plaintiff filed a complaint case and on the basis of the said complaint a case FIR No.719/2015 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC was registered at PS Gandhi Nagar, Delhi against the defendant and his family members and the same is pending before the court of Ms. Harshita Vatsayan, Ld. M.M.,
Karkardooma Courts, Delhi.

It is further averred that prior to register the above mentioned FIR, the defendant issued a cheque bearing no. 947787 for a sum of Rs.7.5 lacs, drawn on State Bank of India, Sector 31, Faridabad, Haryana, dated 14.07.2015 in the name of the plaintiff for the purpose of settlement of matrimonial disputes with the assurance that the said cheque would be encashed on its presentation.

It is further averred that as per the instruction and direction of the defendant, the plaintiff has presented the said cheque with her Banker but the said cheque got bounced with Smt. Rekha vs Sh. Hitesh Kumar on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159220287/
1 remarks "Payment Stopped" vide returning memo dated 17.07.2015.

sentences.text: It is further averred that despite repeated requests and demand of the plaintiff on various occasion, the defendant has not returned the cheque amount of Rs.7.5 lacs alongwith interest till today.
Thereafter, the plaintiff sent a legal notice to the defendant on 28.06.2018 but despite service of the said legal notice, the defendant has not paid any amount to the plaintiff.
Hence, the present suit.
3 Summons for appearance under Order 37 CPC was received back served on 17.11.2022.
However, no appearance has been filed by the defendant as per the mandate of Order 37 CPC within stipulated period of 10 days.
4 Before proceeding further, it is worthwhile to mention that this court does have jurisdiction to try the present suit and also the same has been filed well within limitation.

5 Provision of Order 37 Rule 2 (3) CPC reads as under:-
"(3) The defendant shall not defend the suit referred to in sub-rule (1) unless he enters an appearance and in default of his entering an appearance the allegation in the plaint shall be deemed to be admitted and the plaintiff shall be entitled to a decree for any sum not exceeding the sum mentioned in the summons together with interest at the rate specified, if any, up to the date of the decree and such sum for costs as may be determined by the High Court from time to time by rules made in that behalf and such decree may be executed forthwith."
6

Since the defendant failed to enter appearance within the stipulated period of 10 days of service of summons of appearance, therefore, in terms of Order 37 Rule 2 (3) CPC, the contents of the plaint are deemed to have been admitted.
Hence, plaintiff is entitled to the decree for the sum of Rs.7,50,000/- (Rupees Seven Lacs Fifty Thousand only).
7 The plaintiff has also claimed pendente-lite interest.
However, there is no agreement on record in this regard.

Therefore, in the absence of any agreement between the parties, Section 34 CPC empowers the court to order interest in a money decree as the court deems reasonable from the date of the suit to the date of decree and in case of commercial transaction, the rate of interest may exceed 6% per annum but shall not exceed the rate at which moneys are lent or advanced by nationalized bank in relation to commercial transactions.

8 In view of aforesaid discussion, present suit is decreed in favour of plaintiff and against defendant for a sum of Rs.7,50,000/-
(Rupees Seven Lacs Fifty Thousand only) alongwith pendente-lite interest @ 6% per annum from date of filing of the suit till the realization of the amount.
Cost of suit is also awarded in favour of the plaintiff.
Decree sheet be prepared accordingly.
9 File be consigned to record room after necessary compliance.
